measured: one frame per shot read by four readers; camera motion measured frame to frame

setups.name: Agent close-up
setups.framing: Frontal; the block fills the width, top edge 36% down, bottom 87%, eyes 50-57%, legs cut.
setups.motion: Locked off; now and then a punch-in.

setups.name: Lead, head and torso
setups.framing: Eye height, close; face 28 to 30% across and 62% down, head 35 to 55% of the frame, turned toward the agent with room on that side; the caption above the head.
setups.motion: Locked off; opens 60 of 64 reels; ping-pongs with the agent close-up.

setups.name: Agent full body
setups.framing: Just above the block's top, 5 to 10 degrees down; the block 45 to 80% of the width, big soft keycaps in the lower corners.
setups.motion: Locked off; sometimes a two-size punch-in on one line.

setups.name: Dashboard
setups.framing: The card wall is the subject, readable; both characters 20 to 25% tall in the lower corners.

setups.name: Lead seated
setups.framing: Head height; face 31% across, the figure 55 to 75% of the frame height, the city in a top corner.

setups.name: Key level
setups.framing: The camera at key level: near keys at the bottom, the card wall filling the frame, the agent cut by the right edge, a sliver of the lead at the left.
setups.motion: Usually just before the closing wide.

setups.name: Agent three-quarter
setups.framing: The block turned 25 to 30 degrees, the camera at its head height, about 80% of the width.

setups.name: Lead small under the board
setups.framing: The lead's camera pulled back: face 35% across and 76% down, the cards sharp above.

setups.name: Closing wide
setups.framing: Low wide: the card grid mid-frame, the lead about 25% across and the agent 75%, each about 15% tall.
setups.motion: Always last, about 1.6 s; a third of the reels fade to black (0.7 s, then 0.2 s of black).

setups.name: Lead lit by a phone
setups.framing: The head-and-torso shot with a glowing phone lighting the face from below.
setups.motion: A gag, a few shots a reel at most.

setups.name: Lead with the city behind
setups.framing: The reverse angle: the camera turned from the dashboard toward the night-city window; split light on the face.

setups.name: Wide from above
setups.framing: 30 to 40 degrees down: keys in the lower half, the lead left, the agent right.
setups.motion: A short push; silent beats, mostly 38 to 74% into the reel.

setups.name: Top-down
setups.framing: 60 to 85 degrees down over the keys, the lead upper left.
